div.h3: Heating curve: pour in heat, watch it climb in steps
div.div: Heat ice until it melts, warms, and boils. Temperature rises while one phase warms (q = mcΔθ) but holds steady during a phase change (q = mL).

section.p: Commit to what temperature does before adding heat.
